summary: A small helper that joins CSS class names together and resolves Tailwind styling conflicts.
purpose: Let screens combine class names, including conditional ones, without styling clashes.
why: Likely reason: the standard way to combine Tailwind class names, so later classes override earlier conflicting ones.
how: 1. Accepts any number of class names, lists, or conditional values. 2. Joins them into one text string. 3. Removes earlier classes that conflict with later ones, so the last one wins.
inputs: Any mix of class name text, arrays, and true or false conditions.
outputs: One class name string that the page can use.
risks: Only as good as the class names given. A later class silently overrides an earlier one, which can hide a style change.
debug: If a style does not appear, look at the final combined string in the browser and check which class came later.
